## What

One or two sentences. Link the Linear ticket if there is one.

## Why

The reason, in words a designer and an engineer both accept. For a token change, the design reason (TOKENS.md section 7).

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes locally
- [ ] Token change: tier respected (alias, not value), light and dark both updated, contrast checked
- [ ] Component change: anatomy, props and states in the component README; stories cover every variant and state
- [ ] Changeset added (`pnpm changeset`) if a published package changed
- [ ] Decision recorded in the Notion decision log if this changes a rule
